camel_example: aliyun dds DescribeAvailabilityZones --region cn-hangzhou --MongoType dbfs --StorageType local_ssd --EngineVersion '5.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry' --ReplicationFactor 3 --DBInstanceClass 'dds.mongo.standard' --InstanceChargeType PrePaid --DbType normal --StorageSupport local --AcceptLanguage zh --ExcludeZoneId 'cn-shanghai-g' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType replicate --ExcludeSecondaryZoneId 'cn-shanghai-b'
description_en: Queries the zones supported by MongoDB instances
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例支持的可用区列表
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-availability-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --instance-charge-type PrePaid --db-type normal --resource-group-id rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry --accept-language zh --storage-support local --mongo-type dbfs --storage-type local_ssd --exclude-zone-id cn-shanghai-g --exclude-secondary-zone-id cn-shanghai-b --db-instance-class dds.mongo.standard --engine-version 5.0 --replication-factor 3 --instance-type replicate --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailabilityZones

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html查询
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription. This is the default value.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
PrePaid（默认值）：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The database type of the instance. Valid values:
normal: replica set instance.
sharding: sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的数据库类型。取值：
normal：副本集实例。
sharding：分片集群实例
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the RegionName and ZoneName response parameters. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回参数RegionName和ZoneName的语言，取值说明：
zh：默认值，中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

cloud: displays only the zones that support cloud disk instances.
local: displays only the zones that support local disk instances.
default or empty: displays the zones that support both local disk and cloud disk instances
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型：

cloud：仅展示支持云盘版实例的可用区。
local：仅展示支持本地盘版实例的可用区。
default或空：展示本地盘和云盘版实例都支持的可用区
parameters.name: storage_support

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values: 

cloud_essd1: PL1 ESSD.
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD.
local_ssd: local SSD.

Instances of version 4.4 and later support only cloud disks. If you do not specify this parameter, cloud_essd1 is selected by default.
Instances of version 4.2 and earlier support only local disks. If you do not specify this parameter, local_ssd is selected by default
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值说明： 

cloud_essd1：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘。
local_ssd：SSD本地盘。

4.4及以上版本实例只支持云盘，不填写默认选择cloud_essd1。
4.2及以下版本实例只支持本地盘，不填写默认选择local_ssd
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The zone ID to exclude from the query results in the current region
parameters.help_zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果
parameters.name: exclude_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone ID to exclude from the query results in the current region. You can use this parameter together with ExcludeZoneId to filter out multiple zones
parameters.help_zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果，结合“ExcludeZoneId”实现多可用区过滤
parameters.name: exclude_secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes.

This parameter is supported only for replica set instances
parameters.help_zh:
节点数。

该参数仅支持副本集实例
parameters.name: replication_factor

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values: 
sharding: sharded cluster instance.
replicate: replica set instance or standalone instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值： 
sharding：分片集群实例。
replicate：副本集实例和单节点实例
parameters.name: instance_type

AvailableZones.description_en: The details of the zones available for purchase
AvailableZones.description_zh: 支持购买的可用区资源详情

RegionId.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html） operation to query the region ID
RegionId.description_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html）接口查询

ZoneName.description_en:
The zone name.

The language of the returned value is determined by the AcceptLanguage parameter. For example, if the zone is cn-hangzhou-h:

If AcceptLanguage is set to zh, 杭州 可用区H is returned.
If AcceptLanguage is set to en, Hangzhou Zone H is returned
ZoneName.description_zh:
可用区名称。

根据AcceptLanguage参数的值返回不同的语言。以cn-hangzhou-h可用区为例，示例如下：

AcceptLanguage为zh：杭州 可用区H
AcceptLanguage为en：Hangzhou Zone H
